elements.title: k-Means Clustering Result

details.legend/series: Three clusters shown by color: yellow, purple, teal
details.trend: Three distinct clusters separated spatially in the East-North coordinate space.

elements.summary: This scatter plot shows the result of k-means clustering with three clusters, visually demonstrating the separation of data points into three groups with a silhouette score of about 0.77, indicating appropriate clustering.
